$comment: The adventure's clock and its states. The rulebook has neither; this adventure states both and the estate read them as flags (I-40). Each is a named boolean the engine carries in the adventure state and the encounter tables read through absences.json - never a branch in the engine.
title: The 5 Treasures: flags
label: reading

records.text: The gourd, opened, swallows the sky and day becomes night; closing it brings the daylight back.
The Junior King naps in the Dining Hall once he has overdrunk wine: a state the Master causes by bringing it.
The Chieftain's scattered sheets have been interpreted, so two of the treasures' workings are known without holding them.
The spells that control the Dazzling Golden Cord are known; until then the Cord is inert loot.
